def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    priority_scores[valid_mask] = item / bins[valid_mask]
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    remaining_capacity = bins[valid_mask] - item
    # Prioritize bins with smaller remaining capacity (more efficient use)

    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    import numpy as np
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if np.any(valid):
        target_ratio = 0.3
        target_remaining = bins[valid] * target_ratio
        deviation = np.abs(remaining[valid] - target_remaining)
        priorities[valid] = -deviation
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = remaining >= 0
    with np.errstate(divide='ignore', invalid='ignore'):
        utilization_ratio = item / np.maximum(bins[valid_mask], 1e-12)
        # Penalize very small remaining space logarithmically to avoid extreme penalties
        log_remaining = np.log1p(remaining[valid_mask])
        priority_scores[valid_mask] = utilization_ratio + 0.5 * log_remaining
    return priority_scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    import numpy as np
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    if np.any(valid):
        target_ratio = 0.5
        target_remaining = bins[valid] * target_ratio
        deviation = np.abs(remaining[valid] - target_remaining)
        priorities[valid] = -deviation
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    fit_mask = bins >= item
    remaining = bins[fit_mask] - item
    priorities[fit_mask] = -np.abs(remaining - remaining.mean()) if len(remaining) > 0 else -np.inf
    return priorities
